commentary_title: The lull in demand for large tankers likely to prevail
commentary_summary: The tonne-miles index increased slightly in week 27 despite weak market activity dampening the tonnage demand for VLCCs. The MEG to West Coast India was the only route that had its freight rates stabilised throughout the week. | There is some growing traction towards the Suezmax segment which added to weaker demand for the larger carriers. Tonnage underway towards the East especially saw continued decline amid the waning demand. | Subdued VLCC demand is likely to remain in week 27 with the tonnage underway in the East continuing to decline. Some respite might come from the USG-Caribs route.
